newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Energy plant damaged by heavy rain.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Energy plant damaged by heavy rain.

text.p: FORT COLLINS, Colo., July 29 - Advanced Energy Industries Inc said Tuesday it temporarily stopped production as heavy rains and flash floods caused water and some inventory damage at its plant.

The manufacturer of power delivery systems said it estimated it will resume production 48 hours. It added the flood did not damage its core manufacturing facility, computer systems and telecommunications.
The company said it is assessing the extent of water damage to its buildings and inventory and is taking steps, including sandbagging, to minimize damage from further storms.
Advanced Energy said silted water caused the damage and that clean-up operations are under way. The company added it has business interruption insurance.
The company's stock traded at 26-1/4 Tuesday afternoon, down 1-7/8.
